generation_jobs_count_check.name: generation_jobs_count_check
generation_jobs_count_check.value: "generation_jobs"."requested_count" between 1 and 20 and "generation_jobs"."unit_credits" > 0 and ("generation_jobs"."requested_count" <= 4 or ("generation_jobs"."requested_count" <= 10 and "generation_jobs"."input" ? 'textileSet') or "generation_jobs"."input" ? 'variation')

media_assets_expiry_idx.name: media_assets_expiry_idx
media_assets_expiry_idx.where: "media_assets"."expires_at" is not null and "media_assets"."storage_deleted_at" is null

recharge_paid_check.name: recharge_paid_check
recharge_paid_check.value: ("recharge_orders"."status" = 'paid') = ("recharge_orders"."paid_at" is not null and "recharge_orders"."provider_transaction_id" is not null)

wallet_entry_source_check.name: wallet_entry_source_check
wallet_entry_source_check.value: ("wallet_entries"."kind" in ('consume','refund') and "wallet_entries"."job_id" is not null and "wallet_entries"."item_id" is not null and "wallet_entries"."recharge_id" is null) or ("wallet_entries"."kind" = 'recharge' and "wallet_entries"."recharge_id" is not null and "wallet_entries"."job_id" is null and "wallet_entries"."item_id" is null) or ("wallet_entries"."kind" in ('opening','checkin') and "wallet_entries"."job_id" is null and "wallet_entries"."item_id" is null and "wallet_entries"."recharge_id" is null)
